messages:
morgan_p: Quick postmortem summary for the 03/24 NATS backlog storm: intermittent spikes produced duplicate pagers across regions. Postmortem here: https://redwood.infra/pm/NATS-backlog-03-24. Root causes: bursty producer pattern + alert rule that fires on instantaneous max, plus no cross-region dedupe.
morgan_p: Need targeted follow-ups (owners, safe rollouts, and measurement).
samira: I can pick up the tuning and rollout. Planning a config-first approach (change alert query -> add dedupe key -> PD grouping).
jordan_m: +1. Important to confirm PD grouping actually collapses EU/US duplicates. I'll coordinate with PD admin.
rita_ops: Current alert is firing on: max_over_time(queue_backlog[30s]) > 80. It's too sensitive for high-throughput queues.
rita_ops: Current rule block:
```
alert: nats_queue_high_backlog
expr: max_over_time(nats_queue_backlog[30s]) > 80
labels:
  severity: pager
  team: messaging
```
morgan_p: Suggested approach: move from instantaneous max to a percentile window and add suppression heuristics. Also add explicit severe-bypass.
samira: Proposed action items:
- A: Switch expr to: quantile_over_time(0.95, nats_queue_backlog[1m]) >= 200 (owner: samira, due: 2026-03-26)
- B: Add dedupe_label: queue_signature (owner: jordan_m, due: 2026-03-25)
- C: Implement PD grouping by queue_signature + region; test in staging (owner: jordan_m, due: 2026-03-26)
- D: Paging suppression: limit pages to 1 per queue_signature per 15m unless backlog >= 2500 (owner: rita_ops, due: 2026-03-27)
- E: Update runbook and add pages_per_queue_1h metric + dashboard (owner: morgan_p, due: 2026-03-28)
- F: Rollout canary plan (prod-canary -> prod) with 1h observation windows (owner: samira, due: 2026-03-29)
jordan_m: For B/C: I'll add queue_signature = sha1(queue_name + cluster + topic_hash) as alert label so PD groups true duplicates. Will run synthetic dupes across eu-west/us-east to validate.
rita_ops: Paging suppression sketch:
```
suppress:
  window: 15m
  max_alerts: 1
group_by: [queue_signature]
bypass_if:
  backlog_threshold: 2500
```
rita_ops: Also propose a short-term mitigator: for the next 72h, mute non-critical queues that historically cause noise. I'll list them in the PR.
samira: On the quantile change: this reduces sensitivity to microbursts. We still need a high-severity bypass. I'll set a separate rule: backlog >= 5000 -> severity: sev-1 (no suppression).
alex_k: Agree with quantile and suppression. Two asks: 1) record test plan and failure criteria; 2) measure relative drop in pages and any missed true incidents.
morgan_p: Test plan outline: deploy to staging, run producer load test (3x normal) and confirm pages remain suppressed for short spikes but fire for sustained >200 backlog for >1m. Failure criteria: >10% increase in missed SLO alerts or unhandled backlog > 30m.
jordan_m: Scheduling note: I can push PD grouping change in maintenance window 2026-03-25 03:00 UTC. Will send calendar and PD change log.
samira: I'll open infra PR today: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/495 (WIP). PR will include alert rule change + dedupe_label generator code.
rita_ops: I'll prepare runbook edits and add troubleshooting steps for suppressed pages (how to bypass suppression when on-call suspects a true incident).
oncall-bot: Retro board updated: https://redwood.infra/retro/PM-417. Action items added. Reminder: include links to test artifacts in PR.
morgan_p: Metrics to track for 7 days post-rollout:
- pages_per_queue_1h (goal: <= 20% of baseline for noisy queues)
- pctile_95_queue_backlog (should reflect real backlog)
- suppressed_alerts_count and bypassed_by_threshold_count
- escalation_latency (ensure no regression)
samira: I'll create dashboard \"NATS: pages vs backlog (p95)\" and add a regression alarm if pages drop but pctile_95 rises >5% vs baseline.
alex_k: One more: make sure cross-region dedupe respects clock skew. Use event IDs where possible rather than timestamps.
jordan_m: Good call. queue_signature will be generated from immutable IDs (queue_id, topic_hash) so clocks don't matter.
morgan_p: Timeline recap and owners: A(samira/03-26), B/C(jordan/03-25-26), D(rita/03-27), E(morgan/03-28), F(samira/03-29). Reconvene for verification 2026-03-30 16:00 UTC.
samira: Starting staged rollout after PR approval. Will ping #eng-oncall when canary starts.
rita_ops: I'll also add an entry to the noise-tracking spreadsheet with pre/post page counts.

morgan_p: Thanks team. Main success signals: significant reduction in duplicate pagers and overall pager volume w/o missing real backlog incidents. If anything blocks the rollout, escalate here or DM.
